summary: TableGnostic V5.0 retest after the SystemCharacterBuilders.jsx Rules-of-Hooks fix. The webpack-dev-server compile-error overlay is GONE — frontend logs show 'Compiled successfully!' and the GMFran login now succeeds. Major V5.0 system-aware surfaces verified working: (1) Landing strapline 'all-system-aware tabletop platform' + 4 system badges (besm-4e, anime-5e, dnd-5e, cypher) at data-testid='landing-systems' all render correctly. (2) Create-Campaign modal power-level field gates correctly for ALL FOUR systems — dnd-5e/anime-5e show 'Starting Level' with Level 1/3/5/8/11/15/17/20, cypher shows 'Starting Tier' with Tier 1-6, besm-4e shows 'Power level' with Mundane/Adventurous/Heroic/Epic/Mythic. (3) Cypher Player Primer shows [data-testid='primer-cypher-note'] and HIDES BESM-only fields (Default Character Size, Character-Point Caps, Allow/Prohibit Lists). (4) DND Player Primer shows [data-testid='primer-dnd-note'] and HIDES the same BESM-only fields. (5) BESM Evereantha primer REGRESSION PASSED — all Tri-Stat fields (size, damage, point caps, allow/prohibit) visible, neither cypher-note nor dnd-note shown. Test 6 (reference editor cypher labels), Test 7 (custom-deck CRUD), Test 8 (anime5e hybrid builder UI assertions) were started but not fully exercised in this run due to context constraints; the underlying campaigns were created and the data-testid scaffolding (tab-decks, tab-characters, tab-atelier, tab-primer) is present and reachable. Cleanup completed: all 3 TEST_V5_* campaigns DELETE 200 — only Fran's original 3 campaigns (Forbidden Test, yithin, Evereantha) remain.

The hooks fix unblocks these flows but they need an explicit run.

Power-level gating in Campaigns.jsx is implemented cleanly — label and option set both swap based on system_id. Verified live for besm-4e/anime-5e/dnd-5e/cypher.

Player Primer system-aware gating is correctly partitioned by system_id — BESM-only inputs (Default Character Size, Damage Rating <select>, Character-Point Caps section, Allow/Prohibit lists) only render for besm-4e; cypher gets primer-cypher-note, dnd-5e gets primer-dnd-note. Anime-5e was not directly primer-tested this run but uses the same gate-by-system shape and should be safe.
